profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Trident Systems
profile.summary: Senior Software Engineer with over 10 years experience in full life-cycle software development. Experience in embedded software development in C/C++, Object Oriented Programing, VxWorks, Green Hills MULTI, MATLAB/Simulink, Agile development, DO-178B certification. Performs well under pressure, highly motivated, and can work successfully team environment or autonomously.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Senior member of the engineering system processor group. Responsible for developing state of the art data storage appliances.
• Designed and developed Li-Ion battery backup management system running under embedded Linux OS.
• Designed and implemented storage system enclosure services.
• Provided client support and resolved system software defects.

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
Project software lead engineer and developer for three major avionics subsystems. Responsible for full project development cycle from requirements analysis, design, prototyping, system integration, and FAA DO-178B certification.

• Northrop Grumman Pod Radar Initiative Environmental Cooling System (ECS): Led a team of 3 people in the development and deployment of the ECS PowerPC based controller software. The system featured 12 I/O channels, PID control algorithm, compressor state machine, built in test (BIT), multiple temperature and pressure sensors. Utilized MATLAB Simulink and Green Hills MULTI™ C compiler tools. The ECS is currently in production, fully operational and used by F-16 multi-role fighter jets.

• Boeing KC-767 Arial Refueling Tanker: Lead software engineer responsible for development of embedded real-time controller for a 40KVA AC induction fuel pump. Developed process and supervised 2 engineers in DO-178B code coverage testing with LDRA Testbed. US Air Force awarded Boeing aerial refueling tanker $35 billion contract in 2011.

• Airbus A380 Supplemental Coolant System Controller:  Designed and developed controller software update capability via aircraft CAN bus interface using C and PowerPC MPC555 assembly languages. Designed and developed system software to perform on ground coolant refill. Developed software and test procedures in accordance with DO-178B Level C certification. Performed on-site engineering support and testing in Germany and Italy.

positions.title: Firmware Engineer (Consultant)
positions.description: Responsible for hardware and software development of the Sentry™ Visibility optical sensor data acquisition and signal processing board using RabbitCore RCM3400 microprocessor with Dymanic C programing language. Defined and implemented command line interface (CLI) to allow users to configure and retrieve system data. The Sentry™ Visibility optical sensors are still in production and used in more than 30 countries on 6 continents around the world.
